messages:
alex: Quick postmortem follow-up from the auth rollout: two recurring incident types — short noisy spikes (1-4m) that repeatedly page, and slower degradations (>10m) that need faster detection. Need owners and conservative ETAs for remediation so this doesn't become "repeat offender" behavior.

alex: Proposed actions (A1-A5):
A1) Add hysteresis to auth-timeout alert (reduce pages on micro-blips).
A2) Increase dedupe window for auth-timeout and fingerprint by trace_id/session_id.
A3) Quiet-hours for non-prod routes (23:00-07:00).
A4) Runbook: explicit rollback + verification checklist.
A5) Add CI smoke job simulating bursty auth traffic + dashboard burn-rate tile.

alex: Reply with owner + ETA.

ming: I'll take A1 (hysteresis). Plan: require p99 > 700ms for 3/5 windows (5m windows) before paging. Will backtest last 14 days. ETA 18h.

rebecca: I'll own A2. Current dedupe is 90s; propose 6m for auth-timeout with fingerprint by trace_id and fallback to session_id. Will also add rule to bypass dedupe if sustained >8m. ETA 36h.

ops-bot: Ticket created: ALERT-9999 "auth alert hysteresis + dedupe" -> assigned rebecca, ming.

sam: I'll put the quiet-hours mute for non-prod routes (23:00-07:00) and add a note for DST. ETA 2h.

julie: I'll update the runbook with rollback steps and a minimal verification checklist and draft a CI job spec (k6 profile). Runbook PR by EOD, CI job proposal in 48h.

alex: Thanks. Quick verification query for A1 backtest: `histogram_quantile(0.99, sum(rate(auth_latency_bucket[5m])) by (le))` — post results in the tracker.

ming: noted, I'll paste backtest graphs in the tracker link.

rebecca: PR will include exact alert config diff + comment about excluding internal-bot traces from fingerprinting.

alex: Owner recap: ming=A1(18h), rebecca=A2(36h), sam=A3(2h), julie=A4+A5(EOD/48h). I'll create the tracker and seed tickets. Reconvene in 72h in this thread for status. If blocked ping me directly. :white_check_mark:
